story-context.acceptanceCriteria: 1. Customer Statement - Summary View: GET /api/v1/ar-statements/:customerId?format=SUMMARY displays customer header, statement rows (invoice number, invoice date, invoice amount, amount paid, balance), totals row, and running balance column 2. Customer Statement - Detailed View: GET /api/v1/ar-statements/:customerId?format=DETAILED displays for each invoice sub-rows: receipts applied, credit notes, adjustments, with receipt date, amount, reference. Running balance updates after each transaction 3. Statement Export: GET /api/v1/ar-statements/:customerId/export?format=PDF|EXCEL. PDF includes legal footer with company address/tax code, report hash (SHA256), statement date. Excel includes all columns + formulas for balance calculations. Filename: "Statement_{CustomerCode}_{Date}.pdf" 4. Send to Customer: POST /api/v1/ar-statements/:customerId/send?email=customer@xyz.com queues email job. Email body includes statement attachment (PDF) + message (configurable). System creates delivery tracking record (sentAt, status=SENT, recipientEmail). Notification sent to accountant confirming dispatch 5. Customer Reconciliation Import: POST /api/v1/ar-statements/:customerId/import-reconciliation uploads CSV from customer. Template: InvoiceNumber, CustomerAmount, CustomerPayment, Notes. System parses, matches to system invoices, flags mismatches: if system.amount ≠ customer.amount, mark MISMATCH with colors (red=significant variance, yellow=rounding). Response includes reconciliationID, matchedCount, mismatchCount, list of mismatches 6. Dispute Logging: On reconciliation import, system creates DisputeLog entry for each mismatch: reconciliationID, invoiceID, systemAmount, customerAmount, variance, notes, status=OPEN. Accountant can view dispute grid, add resolution notes, mark RESOLVED. Resolution audit-logged 7. Statement History: System maintains statement history with versioning. Each statement generation creates StatementHistory entry: statementId, customerId, generatedAt, generatedBy, format (SUMMARY/DETAILED), filters applied, exportCount, sentCount. Users can view historical statements and regenerate previous versions 8. Batch Statement Export: GET /api/v1/ar-statements/batch-export?customerIds=id1,id2,id3&format=ZIP generates ZIP file containing individual statement PDFs/Excel files for each customer. ZIP filename: "Statements_{Date}.zip". Each file follows naming convention: "Statement_{CustomerCode}_{Date}.pdf" 9. Dispute Resolution Workflow: Accountant can view dispute grid filtered by status (OPEN/RESOLVED), customer, date range. For each dispute, accountant can add resolution notes, attach supporting documents, mark as RESOLVED. Resolution actions audit-logged with before/after status and resolution reason 10. Statement Notes in Exports: Subsequent statement exports include notes from previous reconciliation disputes. Notes appear in a dedicated "Reconciliation Notes" section at the bottom of PDF/Excel exports. Notes include: dispute date, invoice number, variance amount, resolution status, resolution notes

doc.title: Epic Technical Specification: Sales Invoice Entry & AR Management
doc.snippet: Detailed acceptance criteria for statement generation (summary/detailed views), export (PDF/Excel with hash and legal footer), email functionality with delivery logging, import/reconciliation with mismatch detection, comprehensive history tracking, and dispute logging with audit trail.

doc.title: Epic 5: Accounts Receivable (AR) Module
doc.snippet: Business requirements for customer statement generation and reconciliation functionality, enabling accountants to produce statements, compare with customer-provided statements, track discrepancies, and maintain complete audit trail.

doc.title: Story 5.4: AR Aging Report and Overdue Alerts
doc.snippet: Established patterns for Excel/PDF export with Apache POI/iText, audit logging for all operations, RBAC enforcement at service and API levels, and Redis caching. All export operations include metadata, timestamp, and audit trail. Report generation uses ARAgingExportServiceImpl patterns.

doc.title: Story 4.5: Supplier Statement & Reconciliation
doc.snippet: AP statement reconciliation patterns to reuse: CSV import with mismatch detection, dispute logging entity structure, statement history tracking, email delivery with queue-based jobs, PDF/Excel export with legal footer and hash. AR statements will follow similar patterns but adapted for customer receivables instead of supplier payables.

doc.title: Story 5.1: Sales Invoice Entry, Edit, and Draft Management
doc.snippet: SalesInvoice entity with complete invoice details (invoice_number, invoice_date, due_date, total_amount, amount_paid, remaining_balance, status). Service patterns with @Transactional, @PreAuthorize annotations. Multi-tenancy with CompanyScopedEntity pattern. Invoice status tracking for statement aggregation.

doc.title: Story 5.3: Customer Payment Receipts (Linked Receivables, Standalone Entry)
doc.snippet: ARPayment and ReceiptAllocation entities track payment history with receipt number, date, amount, and allocated amount. Payment allocation logic and receipt tracking established. Receipt allocations used for detailed statement views showing payment sub-rows.

doc.title: Story 5.2: Invoice Approval Workflow (Maker-Checker)
doc.snippet: Approval workflow patterns with email notification, queue-based jobs, and audit logging. Statement generation should only include POSTED invoices (approval workflow complete). Email delivery patterns established for approval notifications can be reused for statement delivery.

package.note: For PDF export with legal footer and hash

constraints.constraint: Multi-Tenancy: All statement entities (StatementHistory, DisputeLog, StatementDelivery) must extend CompanyScopedEntity interface and implement company_id field. All queries must be filtered by CompanyContext.getCompanyId().

RBAC Enforcement: Accountant can generate/send statements for assigned customers; Chief Accountant can view all statements and disputes; Admin can manage dispute resolutions. Use @PreAuthorize annotations at service and controller methods.

TT200 Compliance: Statement exports must follow TT200 format requirements including legal footer with company address and tax code, SHA-256 hash generation for document integrity, and proper Vietnamese formatting (currency: #,##0.00₫, dates: dd/MM/yyyy).

Audit Logging: All statement operations (generation, export, email, import, reconciliation, dispute updates) must be logged via AuditService with action, user, timestamp, IP address, and change details.

Service Layer Patterns: Use @Transactional for data modifications, @Cacheable for read operations where appropriate (frequently accessed statements), and @PreAuthorize for RBAC enforcement. Follow naming convention: ARStatementService with ARStatementServiceImpl in service/impl/sales/ package.

Database Design: Create new entities for statement history (StatementHistory), dispute logging (DisputeLog), and delivery tracking (StatementDelivery) with proper indexes on customer_id, company_id, generated_at, status (for DisputeLog), and reconciliation_id for query performance.

Export Patterns: Use iText/JasperReports for PDF generation with proper formatting (company header, customer header, statement table, legal footer with hash). Use Apache POI (XSSFWorkbook) for Excel generation with formulas for balance calculations. Include metadata (customer, period, timestamp) and hash in exported files.

Email Integration: Use async queue-based email jobs (Spring Async or message queue) to avoid blocking API responses. Track delivery status (SENT/DELIVERED/FAILED) with StatementDelivery entity. Implement rate limiting: max 100 emails per minute. Support batch email delivery with queue management.

Reconciliation Logic: Use tolerance-based matching (variance >1000 VND = SIGNIFICANT/red, variance ≤1000 VND = ROUNDING/yellow). Match invoices by invoice number (case-insensitive, trim whitespace). Create DisputeLog entries for each mismatch with status=OPEN. Support partial matches (some invoices matched, some not).

Statement Calculation: On-demand computation (no pre-computed cache like aging reports, but can cache for frequently accessed customers). Query POSTED invoices only. Exclude REVERSED and PAID invoices (balance = 0). Calculate running balance: start with opening balance (if any), then cumulative after each transaction. Include customer header information from Customer entity.

Frontend Structure: Create feature under features/accounting/pages/Statements/ following feature-first structure. Reuse existing DataTable components, export functionality, and dialog patterns from ARAging and Receipts components. Use shadcn/ui components consistently.

tests.standards: Follow testing patterns established in Stories 5.1-5.4: Use TestContainers with PostgreSQL for integration tests. Test all service operations with company-scoped data isolation. Verify RBAC enforcement at service and API levels. Test export functionality (Excel and PDF formats) with TT200 compliance including legal footer and SHA256 hash. Test import and reconciliation logic with various scenarios (matched, mismatched, rounding variance, significant variance). Verify dispute logging and resolution workflows. Test statement history tracking and batch operations (ZIP download, batch email). Validate email functionality with async queue (mocked for tests). Test audit logging for all operations. Use JUnit 5 for backend tests and Vitest + Testing Library for frontend component tests.
